title: Reported Questions and Commands
grammarNote: Косвенные вопросы и приказы следуют другим правилам, чем косвенные утверждения. В косвенных вопросах слова НЕ ИНВЕРТИРУЮТСЯ (как в indirect questions), а времена сдвигаются назад. В косвенных приказах и просьбах используется структура told/asked + person + to + infinitive.

grammarTable.subject: Reported wh-question
grammarTable.example: "What time is it?" → He asked what time IT WAS.

grammarTable.subject: Reported yes/no Q
grammarTable.example: "Are you coming?" → She asked whether I WAS COMING.

grammarTable.subject: Direct command (+)
grammarTable.example: "Study harder!" → He told her TO STUDY harder.

grammarTable.subject: Negative command
grammarTable.example: "Don't be late!" → She told me NOT TO BE late.

grammarTable.subject: Reported request
grammarTable.example: "Please help me." → He asked me TO HELP him.

grammarTable.subject: Negative request
grammarTable.example: "Please don't tell anyone." → She asked me NOT TO TELL anyone.

grammarExtra.title: Reported Questions — word order NEVER inverts

rows.example: Reported: "He asked where the library WAS." (NOT "where WAS the library")
Reported: "She asked what time it STARTED." (NOT "did it start")
"He asked whether I WAS COMING." (NOT "was I coming")
"She asked if I HAD APPLIED." (NOT "had I applied")

rows.form: Positive command: told + person + to + inf
rows.example: "Come to my office." → He told me TO COME to his office.

rows.form: Negative command: told + person + not to + inf
rows.example: "Don't submit late." → She told me NOT TO SUBMIT late.
"Please open the window." → She asked me TO OPEN the window.

rows.form: Negative request: asked + person + not to + inf
rows.example: "Please don't tell." → She asked me NOT TO TELL.

rows.form: "What do you want?" → asked what I WANTED
rows.example: "What do you want?" → She asked what I WANTED. (do → -)

rows.form: "Where are you from?" → asked where I WAS FROM
rows.example: "Where are you from?" → He asked where I WAS FROM. (are → was)

rows.form: "Have you been there?" → asked if I HAD BEEN
rows.example: "Have you been?" → She asked if I HAD BEEN. (have → had)

rows.form: "Will you come?" → asked if I WOULD COME
rows.example: "Will you come?" → He asked if I WOULD COME. (will → would)
✅ "He asked where THE LIBRARY WAS." — NO inversion in reported questions!
✅ "She asked whether I HAD APPLIED." — no "did" in reported questions!
✅ "He told ME to study harder." — told MUST have a person object!
✅ "He asked me TO STUDY harder." — must include "to"!

grammarTip:
Косвенные вопросы и приказы:
① ВОПРОСЫ — никакой инверсии:
"Where IS the library?" → He asked where the library WAS.
НЕ "where WAS the library"!

② YES/NO вопросы → whether / if:
"Are you coming?" → She asked WHETHER I WAS COMING.

③ ПРИКАЗЫ → told/asked + person + to + inf:
"Come here!" → He told me TO COME there.
"Don't be late!" → She told me NOT TO BE late.

💡 Важное различие:
told = команда/инструкция
asked = вежливая просьба

"He TOLD me to leave." (приказал)
"He ASKED me to leave." (попросил)

exercises.text: "Where is the office?" → She asked where ___.
exercises.hint: No inversion + backshift. "She asked where THE OFFICE WAS." ✅

exercises.text: "Are you coming?" → He asked whether I ___ .
exercises.hint: yes/no → whether + backshift. "He asked WHETHER I WAS COMING." ✅

exercises.instruction: Convert the command to reported speech.
exercises.hint: "told + person + to + infinitive." "She told her TO STUDY harder." ✅

exercises.text: "He asked where was the library." — What is wrong?
opts: The word order is inverted — should be "where the library was"
exercises.correct: The word order is inverted — should be "where the library was"
exercises.hint: ✅ "He asked where THE LIBRARY WAS." — no inversion in reported questions!

exercises.text: "Don't be late!" → She told him ___ late.
exercises.hint: Negative command: told + person + NOT TO + infinitive. "She told him NOT TO BE late." ✅
"asked + person + to + infinitive." "He asked me TO HELP him." ✅

exercises.text: "What time does the lecture start?" → She asked what time the lecture ___.
exercises.hint: No inversion + backshift: "does start" → "started". "She asked what time the lecture STARTED." ✅

exercises.text: "Did you apply?" → He asked ___ I had applied.
exercises.hint: yes/no question → "if" or "whether". "He asked IF I HAD APPLIED." ✅ (did → had)

exercises.text: "Will she come?" → She asked whether he ___ .
exercises.hint: will → would in reported speech. "She asked whether he WOULD COME." ✅

exercises.text: Professor Aidarov ___ us to read Aitmatov for next week.
exercises.hint: "told + person + to + inf" = instruction/command. "He TOLD us to read Aitmatov." ✅ (told = more directive than asked)

exercises.text: "Please don't tell anyone about this." → She asked me ___.
exercises.hint: "asked + person + NOT TO + infinitive." "She asked me NOT TO TELL anyone." ✅

exercises.instruction: Report the question with full backshift.
exercises.text: "Have you finished your essay?" → He asked if I ___ my essay.
exercises.hint: Present Perfect → Past Perfect. "He asked if I HAD FINISHED my essay." ✅

questions.text: "Where is the library?" → She asked where ___.
questions.hint: No inversion + backshift. "She asked where THE LIBRARY WAS." ✅

questions.text: "Are you interested?" → He asked ___ I was interested.
questions.hint: yes/no question → "whether" or "if". "He asked WHETHER I WAS interested." ✅
"told + person + to + infinitive." "She told us TO READ the handbook." ✅

questions.text: "Don't use your phone!" → He told them ___ their phones.
questions.hint: "told + person + NOT TO + infinitive." "He told them NOT TO USE their phones." ✅

questions.text: "What does WKU stand for?" → She asked what WKU ___ for.
questions.hint: No inversion + backshift. "does stand" → "stood". "She asked what WKU STOOD for." ✅

questions.text: "Will you help?" → She asked if I ___ help.
questions.hint: Backshift: will → would. "She asked if I WOULD help." ✅

questions.text: "He asked where was the office." is correct.
questions.hint: ✅ "He asked where THE OFFICE WAS." — no inversion in reported questions!
"asked + person + to + infinitive." "She asked me TO COME early." ✅

questions.text: What is the difference between "told" and "asked" in commands?
questions.hint: "He TOLD me to leave." (strong instruction) vs "He ASKED me to leave." (polite request).

questions.text: "Did she apply?" → He asked if she ___ applied.
questions.hint: Backshift: did → had. "He asked if she HAD APPLIED." ✅

questions.text: "Please don't tell anyone." → She asked me ___.
questions.hint: "asked + person + NOT TO + infinitive." "She asked me NOT TO TELL anyone." ✅

questions.text: "Who is in charge?" → She asked who ___ in charge.
questions.hint: No inversion + backshift. "is" → "was". "She asked who WAS in charge." ✅

questions.text: "Why didn't you come?" → He asked why I ___ come.
questions.hint: Backshift: "didn't" → "hadn't". "He asked why I HADN'T come." ✅
"told + person + to + infinitive." "She TOLD ME TO STUDY." ✅

questions.text: "Are you a student?" → She asked ___ I was a student.
questions.hint: "if" or "whether" for yes/no questions. "She asked IF/WHETHER I was a student." ✅
Commands/requests: "told/asked + person + to + base verb." "He TOLD ME TO come." ✅
